metadata.description: Trial balance - accounts with debits, credits and balance by date range (Spain)

module.name: trial_balance
module.description: Trial balance. Group journal items by account (account_id), sum debits and credits.

rules.rule: Use debit, credit fields in account.move.line. Balance = debit - credit.
Dates: date in account.move.line (or date in account.move if filtering by move).
Accounts: account_id (account.account). Exclude lines without account: ('account_id', '!=', False).
Sorting: sorted(result, key=operator.itemgetter('codigo')). operator is preloaded. Do NOT sort records directly.
Variables: define start_date and end_date (str 'YYYY-MM-DD') before the domain.

OUTPUT COLUMNS: The final output MUST ALWAYS contain exactly these columns, regardless of the grouping level: 1. número de cuenta or dígitos al nivel requerido (codigo), 2. nombre de la cuenta o agrupación (cuenta), 3. debe, 4. haber, 5. saldo.
